title: MacArthur's 1955 West Point interplanetary war speech

tellings.quote: During a 1955 speech at West Point, General MacArthur told assembled cadetses, "The next war will be an interplanetary war.

plain: In a 1955 speech at West Point, the US Army's officer academy, General Douglas MacArthur is said to have told the cadets: "The next war will be an interplanetary war." Michels quotes this himself in his narration, without naming a source. If MacArthur said it, one of America's best-known generals was talking openly about a threat from beyond Earth.
